summary: Saudi Arabia and UAE urge US to maintain sanctions and naval blockade on Iran while Qatar seeks to mediate Hormuz reopening; Iran proposes 7-day conditions to resume talks. IDF killed two Hamas militants including Oct 7 commander involved in hostage-taking; two IDF soldiers died in FPV drone accident in Gaza. Israeli artillery targets Al-Mansouri in southern Lebanon; Saudi coalition suffers losses in Yemen.
key_points: Saudi Arabia and UAE urge Washington to maintain sanctions and naval blockade of Iran as attacks threaten oil exports; Qatar seeks talks in Oman next week to reopen Hormuz (Source: @Faytuks_Network/7514).
Iran FM Araghchi proposed to US via intermediaries to reopen Hormuz and resume negotiations, giving Washington 7 days to implement conditions (Source: @VahidOnline/78520).
IDF killed Hamas commander Hassan Mahmoud Tiama, involved in Oct 7 attack and holding hostages Ofra Silver, Kith, Aviva Segal, Daphne Eliyahu (Source: @idf_telegram/25224).
Two IDF reservists Nadav Kali and Ofek Moalem killed by FPV drone explosion in Gaza buffer zone north; all small explosive drones grounded (Source: @manniefabian/59236).
Israeli forces target Al-Mansouri southern Lebanon with artillery shells (Source: @presstv/208272).
Saudi coalition suffered dozens killed/wounded near Jabal Naman Waziah district Yemen; 3 drones downed, vehicles destroyed (Source: @naya_foriraq/91564).
Najaf airport suspended all Iran flights; Erbil and Sulaymaniyah also suspended Iranian flights from Friday (Source: @mamlekate/104624).
Trump-Xi meeting focused trade and AI with silence on Iran war; US ambassador claims China confirmed not supporting Iran (Source: @SharghDaily/185745).

sections.threat_assessment: Iran's warning that flights in the region must be free for all or none, combined with Saudi-UAE pressure to maintain sanctions and blockade, signals potential for further Hormuz escalation. Qatar's mediation effort suggests diplomatic channels remain open but fragile. IDF operations in Gaza and Lebanon indicate continued kinetic activity despite ceasefire claims. FPV drone accident raises safety concerns over IDF drone operations.
sections.regional_response: Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan military chiefs convened urgently to activate Mecca Agreement against Ansarullah, indicating coordinated Gulf response to Yemen threats. Saudi oil rerouting through Oman and VLCC shortage demonstrate economic vulnerability to Hormuz disruption. Iran's Supreme Leader adviser framed flight freedom as regional principle, signaling potential retaliation if sanctions persist.
sections.intelligence_notes: US-China talks at White House deliberately avoided Iran war topic; US ambassador claimed China confirmed non-support for Iran, suggesting diplomatic pressure on Beijing. Reuters reports Saudi oil transfers at Hormuz capacity limit with 10-day wait times, creating economic incentive for rapid resolution. IDF internal investigation into drone accident may reveal operational vulnerabilities in FPV employment.
